decisions.name: go-api-contracts
decisions.reason: Only Store tests change; the exported API, key/value contract, dependencies and module minimum remain unchanged.

decisions.name: go-core-style
decisions.reason: Writing Go test code benefits from idiomatic naming, explicit error handling, formatting and race verification.

decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
decisions.reason: No interface, constructor, dependency wiring or production resource lifecycle changes; test fixture lifetime is covered by go-test-isolation.

decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
decisions.reason: Tests remain in the existing filestore_test package; no package responsibility, location or import ownership changes.

decisions.name: go-test-isolation
decisions.reason: Tests exercise real files, parallel independent Store instances, grouped descendant lifetime and focused subtest selection.

scope: Only the authorized standalone dispatch, isolated module, selected offered guidance and own reports were read. No other repository or author workspace was inspected.
